SUBJECT:  Recommendation to Approve Agreements for Uniforms 
 
 
 
The Nashua School District has been under contract for purchasing team uniforms since 2011.  
We are seeking approval for a five-year agreement with BSN Sports and Under Armour for their 
discount and rewards programs.  For the past fifteen years, we have discovered that using a 
single vendor to provide a single name brand team uniform has not only simplified the 
purchasing process but has also outfitted each of our teams in equivalent quality uniforms.  
Uniforms for all programs in all five secondary schools are replaced on a rotating cycle. 
 
We are requesting approval for two agreements:  one with BSN Sports and the other with 
Under Armour.  The Athletic Department been working with both companies and  for several 
years for equipment, supplies, apparel, and some uniforms.  The rewards offered within each 
agreement will provide additional uniforms, apparel, and equipment for teams. 
 
The Under Armour uniform line is priced fairly and is known for its quality and durability.  The 
Under Armour product is available in all five of our secondary school colors.  
 
In addition to receiving discounts and rebates directly from Under Armour for team uniforms, 
BSN Sports also offers a rebate/credit system for other products purchased through their 
company.  This will be an added benefit to the Nashua Athletic Department as we are already 
spending a significant amount of our equipment and supplies budget with them. 
 
Recommendation to approve the five-year rewards agreements with BSN Sports and Under 
Armour.

Subject:  Recommendation to Partner with Leaders Atlas – Mosaic Storytelling Program 
 
Background 
One of the priorities identified within the District's Strategic Communication Plan is to improve 
proactive communication by sharing consistent, meaningful stories that highlight the work 
occurring in every school. While our district has many outstanding accomplishments each day, 
capturing and communicating those stories consistently across nineteen schools and nearly 90 
administrators remains challenging. 
 
The Mosaic Storytelling Program provides a structured and efficient process that enables school 
leaders to document and share examples of student learning, staff innovation, and strategic 
initiatives with minimal additional workload. The platform creates a centralized repository of 
stories that can be repurposed for BOE updates, school/district newsletters, social media, 
community engagement, and strategic planning updates. 
 
Alignment with the District Strategic Communication Plan 
• Expanding transparent and proactive communication with families and the community. 
• Celebrating student achievement, staff excellence, and innovative instructional practices. 
• Strengthening stakeholder confidence through authentic storytelling from every school. 
• Providing consistent messaging aligned with the District's Strategic Plan and Portrait of a 
Learner. 
• Demonstrating progress toward district goals using real examples from classrooms rather 
than solely relying on quantitative measures. 
 
Most importantly, the program shifts district communications from reporting isolated events to 
telling the ongoing story of the Nashua School District—showcasing how our educators and 
students are living our mission of providing personalized educational opportunities and cultivating 
the skills and perspectives necessary for meaningful contributions to our community. 
 
Project Overview 
• Equip approximately 90 building administrators with a simple storytelling process 
requiring approximately 10–15 minutes per story. 
• Highlight examples of the District's Strategic Plan in action across all schools. 
• Increase the volume and quality of positive district communications while reducing 
demands on the staff to manual seek out stories. 
• Build a searchable archive documenting progress toward strategic goals. 
• Provide leadership with Board-ready reports, recognition materials, and communication 
resources throughout the school year.

Scope of Work 
The proposed one-year engagement (July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027) includes: 
• Development of a customized Nashua District Story Showcase branded for the District. 
• Four facilitated storytelling workshops, beginning with the August Administrator Retreat. 
• Continuous story collection throughout the school year. 
• Periodic refresh of prompts to align with evolving district priorities. 
• Monthly planning meetings with the Superintendent's Office and Communications 
Department. 
• Ongoing technical support. 
• Following each storytelling cycle, delivery of: 
o Updated searchable Story Showcase 
o Thematic reports aligned to Strategic Plan priorities 
o Leadership presentation materials 
o Ready-to-publish social media graphics and captions 
o Communication resources for Board meetings and district publications. 
 
Financial Impact 
The annual implementation cost is $20,000, with a discounted rate of $18,000 if paid in full upon 
execution of the agreement. The fee includes all workshops, continuous platform hosting, reporting, 
technical support, and communication deliverables for the duration of the program. 
 
Recommendation to approve the Superintendent to enter into a one-year agreement with 
Leaders Atlas to implement the Mosaic Storytelling Program for the 2026–2027 school year at 
a cost not to exceed $18,000.00.
